en: Color postcard view of a large river curving through a green landscape with meadows on the inside of the bend. A historic white paddle steamer with a red‑topped smokestack and many passengers is sailing in the foreground; the name "RIESA" is visible on the side of the vessel. On the right bank stands a hilltop complex dominated by a large Gothic‑style church with tall spire and attached castle‑like buildings overlooking a town of red‑roofed houses. Bridges cross the river in the middle distance, and low wooded hills form the background.
